newsitem.title: INDIA: Bank of Nova Scotia cuts India prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Nova Scotia cuts India prime lending rate.

text.p: The Bank of Nova Scotia is reducing its Indian prime lending rate to 17.5 percent per annum from 18.5 percent with effect from November 1, the treasury manager at its Bombay office said on Tuesday.
The new rate would be exclusive of tax, Himanshu Bhatt, the treasury manager, told Reuters. He said the maximum spread above the prime lending rate would be three percent.
The bank's decision follows Reserve the Bank of India's initiatives in its October 19 monetary policy to ease liquidity and prompt interest cuts.
